paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 2.55, with a change of -3.77 percent versus the prior close and -43.96 percent over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of October 23, 2026.

Recent news headlines include Fermi facing a deep reset and the launch of a $350 million convertible notes offering, which led to an 18 percent decline in the stock price after-hours. The company is reshaping its funding strategy to accelerate AI infrastructure development and has outlined a new financing approach for Project Matador focused on capital efficiency.

There have been recent SEC filings, including four Form 4 filings and three Form 144 filings, with the most recent filings occurring on October 22 and October 20. An 8-K filing on October 16 announced an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
